user.title: Set up Streaming Browser
user.description: Install the dashboard card and enable independent episode links. Your existing dashboard card configuration will be preserved.

init.title: JustWatch account
init.description: Optional. Anonymous JustWatch and WatchHub links work without an account. Linking uses JustWatch's unofficial sign-in service. Account tokens stay in Home Assistant, not the dashboard.

menu_options.email: Connect JustWatch with email and password
menu_options.token: Connect with a browser ID token (expires)

email.title: Connect JustWatch
email.description: Sign in to JustWatch. Your password is exchanged for a renewable account session and is not saved.

token.title: JustWatch browser ID token
token.description: For a social-login account, enter a valid JustWatch browser ID token. It cannot be refreshed automatically and will eventually expire.

disconnect.title: Disconnect JustWatch account
disconnect.description: Remove the saved JustWatch session from Streaming Browser. Anonymous provider links will remain available.

error.invalid_auth: JustWatch authentication was rejected or could not be completed. Verify the credentials and connection.
